items.Sentence: Grinder pumps are used in lift stations to grind wastewater prior to Pond 1.
A grease trap is located in the school kitchen and is maintained by staff monthly.

The treatment system consists of a series of eight unlined oxidation/percolation ponds covering approximately 2.5 acres throughout the Monterey Bay Academy facility. The ponds are periodically drained and cleaned to remove settled solids.
Historically, wastewater from the treatment and disposal ponds had been occassionally reclaimed on approximaltey 35 acres of nearby fodder crops, but is no longer being land applied.
